description: PR4 replay validation results (docs/chip_timing_spec.md §4.4). Season 2324, GW1-4, off vs greedy vs auto chip strategies. Run at reduced fidelity (see notes) due to compute constraints - see NOTES.md 'Chip timing validation results' section for full caveats and honest interpretation.

settings.note: num_iterations=15 (vs production default 100) only reduces the GA population/generations used by run_optimization's own tree search (fill_initial_squad and any wildcard/free-hit branch actually applied by the winning strategy). It does NOT reduce chip_timing.py's own internal wildcard/free-hit value ESTIMATORS (estimate_wildcard_value/estimate_free_hit_value), which still ran at num_iterations=100 - this asymmetry is a known confound, see NOTES.md.
